semanticHashFormat: SHA256 of UTF8 JSON with sorted object keys, no whitespace and original list order, ensure_ascii=false. Full original JSON files remain verbatim in taskroot and original artifact ZIPs, separately indexed by byte SHA256.
requiredSdkAndChannelAssertions: Each schema3 report notificationApiLevel must be an integer exactly equal to the matrix and independently queried AVD SDK. API24 channel fields must be exact notApplicable; API33/35/36 exact true.
storageComparisonScope: Cancellation/Settings compare the same actual SQLite snapshot plus every table including sqlite_sequence with no field omissions. Model persistence uses the existing fixture canonical form: recursively keep every field and sort only lists of entities with string IDs by ID. Protection uses the actual pre-restore stored snapshot.
scope: Synthetic isolated AVDs only. This snapshot is independent from historical 641/68/682 failures, which remain intact. Four-phase success is claimed only when raw reports, flags, SDK/channel rules, SQL evidence, actual APK identity and both forced process reopens all pass the independent review. A final stage XML records the last screen for that stage; observed switch states and one-time acknowledgements are additionally recorded by driver events, corroborated by native permission diagnoses. API24 has independently verified four-phase success with all 13 flags, exact channel notApplicable and both forced process reopens. API33/35/36 each have only two schema2 successes; their raw UI/events/runtime establish deliberate denial followed by PermissionHelper kill and a different logical runId. A durable same-run Settings checkpoint is required before retrying, while genuine denial and all business assertions remain mandatory.
